parsed_results.text: This is about running the job once, not doing more.
We retried failed notifications, not failed payments.
Unlike Lee et al. [4], we found no improvement in the smaller sample.
The deployment finally worked. My celebratory dance was mercifully undocumented.
The cache may reduce latency by ~10% for repeated requests, but cold starts are untested.
The tapestry depicts a coastal landscape.
Please send the invoice by Friday.
The team launched the dashboard on Tuesday.
The prototype aims to detect duplicate invoices. We have not tested its accuracy.
The vector represents velocity. The robust regression estimates the slope while limiting outlier effects.
The migration is complete. "Ready to launch," the manager said. We still need to check the backups.

On Tuesday, I deployed the cache to two servers. Median latency fell from 80 ms to 60 ms for repeated requests in a 30‑minute test. We have not tested cold starts or the other eight servers. The dashboard still shows yesterday's data.
